ruleName: Order of Play in Match Play
title: Your Opponent Plays Out of Turn – What Are Your Options?
question: You are playing a match. It is your turn to play first, but your opponent plays before you. Their shot slices into deep trees and leaves them in serious trouble. What are you allowed to do?

choices.text: Require your opponent to cancel the stroke and play again in the correct order.
Allow the stroke to stand and let your opponent play from where the ball finished.
Either A or B – the choice is yours.
Your opponent automatically receives a one-stroke penalty.

explanation: In match play, if your opponent plays out of turn, you may either require them to cancel the stroke and play again in the correct order, or allow their stroke to stand and continue from the resulting position. This is your choice, announced immediately. There is no automatic penalty for playing out of turn in match play. (Rule 6.4a)

juniorVersion.title: What Can You Do If Your Opponent Hits First?
juniorVersion.question: You and your friend are playing a match. It is your turn to hit, but your friend goes first and hits their ball into some deep trees. What are you allowed to do?

choices.text: Ask your friend to hit their shot again, but this time in the right order.
Let your friend play from where their ball went into the trees.
You can pick A or B – you get to choose.
Your friend gets a one-shot penalty without you doing anything.

juniorVersion.explanation: If your friend hits when it was your turn, you get to choose: they can hit again in the right order, or you can let them play from where the ball stopped. There is no automatic penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A type of golf game where you try to win each hole against another player.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Talk about how taking turns is important in match play, but there's a choice if someone goes out of turn.
likelyMisconceptions: Kids may wrongly think the friend always gets a penalty for hitting out of turn.
Kids may think you have no choice and must let them play the shot.
